_note: Added by By Mel Ross (0.12.0). The kinds of reel the home page offers. Only formats with "status": "ready" are shown: a format appears on the page the day it is built, never as 'coming soon'. 'ask' is what the copied request says; SKILL.md says how each one is carried out.

formats.name: Talking head
formats.does: You, talking to the camera. Pauses and filler cut, captions on, a title in the first seconds.

styles.name: Simple
styles.does: Clean cuts, captions and a hook title. A few graphics at most.
styles.ask: as a simple talking head: clean cuts, captions, a hook title, and only a few graphics

styles.name: With graphics
styles.does: The same, plus a graphic for most ideas: lists, labels, numbers, your pictures and GIFs.
styles.ask: as a talking head with graphics: lots of graphics, and show me the looks page so I can pick

formats.name: Talking head with B-roll
formats.does: Your own clips laid over your voice.

formats.name: Split screen
formats.does: Two clips at once, one above the other.

formats.name: Clips cut to music
formats.does: Short clips cut on the beat of a song, with your lines on screen.

formats.name: Carousel
formats.does: Slides made from your photos and words.
